text: The NIWA–MPI Drought Forecasting Tool is a national sub-seasonal drought outlook system in New Zealand, developed by NIWA and the Ministry for Primary Industries. Launched in October 2023, it provides daily-updated, district-level forecasts of rainfall, dryness, and drought risk up to 35 days ahead. The tool uses the NIWA35 deep learning platform to downscale NOAA's global forecast to New Zealand's terrain, integrating with the New Zealand Drought Index for decision support in drought risk management.
